entries.title: AAL3 v1 (2 mm, MNI Colin27 convention)
entries.citation: Rolls ET, Huang CC, Lin CP, Feng J, Joliot M. Automated anatomical labelling atlas 3. NeuroImage 206:116189 (2020). doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2019.116189
entries.note: The AAL3 readme mentions the GNU GPL, but the site could not be read when this catalog was made: check the terms at the source. The size and sha256 are recorded at the first download, and the member names inside the archive are matched by file name. AAL is in the Colin27 convention: to label a mask of another family, allow it explicitly.

entries.title: HCP-MMP1.0 volumetric projection (1 mm, MNI152 ICBM2009a)
entries.citation: Glasser MF et al. A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178 (2016). doi:10.1038/nature18933. Volumetric projection onto MNI152 ICBM2009a by Andreas Horn, figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.3501911.v5
entries.warning: The author of this volumetric version writes that it should be used and applied with great care, and under certain circumstances only: the fine parcellation was only realizable on the surface, so volumetric nonlinear registration does not suit it.
entries.note: The volume numbers the 180 areas 1-180 on both hemispheres; the loader tells the hemispheres apart by the sign of x and names them L_ or R_. It is on the original McGill ICBM2009a grid (197x233x189), not on TemplateFlow's 2009c grid.
